summary: A Google DeepMind executive announces two new model variants, Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite, describing 3.6 Flash as improving on coding, knowledge work and multimodal performance while reducing token usage.

practices.reason: A named shipped model is claimed to improve coding, multimodal and knowledge-work performance while using fewer tokens, but no benchmark figures are given.
practices.quote: 3.6 Flash: our workhorse model delivers better coding, knowledge work, and multimodal performance while reducing token usage.
